shots.focal_element: Gmail thread where the AI agent answers a pricing question and offers a meeting, pushing in from the right over the Salesforce Leads list
on_screen_text: How much does your solution cost?
Sent by Heather Cartino's AI Agent
Book a meeting with Heather Cartino
shots.typography: Native product UI text only (Salesforce Lightning and Gmail sans-serif, small regular weight, sentence case, bold for edition names and sender names); no designed overlay type.
shots.what_happens: A 0.34 s transitional frame: the Salesforce Leads list view slides out to the left while a Gmail window showing the Einstein agent's email reply (pricing editions, meeting offer, booking card) slides in from the right; VO is on 'by contacting' (w65-w66).
shots.build_rebuild: Place two full-frame UI screenshots side by side in a strip and translate the strip left by one frame width over about 0.4 s with an ease-in-out so the Gmail screenshot replaces the Salesforce one.

shots.focal_element: The Einstein agent's email offering a 'Book a meeting with Heather Cartino' card with a grid of time-slot buttons
on_screen_text: Yes, I would like to meet with Heather.
Sure! Just select your availability with Heather Cartino
Book a meeting with Heather Cartino
shots.typography: Native Gmail UI text: small regular sans-serif in sentence case, bold sender names and day headers, blue time-slot labels in outlined buttons; no added captions.
shots.what_happens: Full-screen Gmail thread scrolls up slowly: the AI agent's pricing reply moves off the top, the prospect's 'Yes, I would like to meet with Heather' reply and the agent's booking card with a three-day grid of time slots scroll into view while VO says 'contacting customers, responding to their questions, and scheduling meetings' (w66-w74); a push to the next shot begins at the right edge in the last frame.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a static Gmail thread mockup taller than the viewport and tween its translateY upward by roughly one third of the frame over 4 s with a gentle ease-out so the booking card lands on screen as VO reaches 'scheduling meetings'.

shots.focal_element: Video call between two people with a Salesforce/Agentforce side panel whose Real Time Insights card changes from 'Scanning.' to a 'Competitor Mention' alert
shots.typography: Native UI text: video-call client labels in small white sans-serif on dark, Salesforce panel in small blue and dark-grey sans-serif, bold title-case card headings; no designed overlay type.
shots.what_happens: Pushes in from the right over the Gmail frame to a video call (two live-action participants side by side, a 'Sales Coach' agent tile among the thumbnails) with a Salesforce panel on the right; the Real Time Insights card reads 'Scanning. Looking for insights.' during 'an AI sales coach agent ... calls with your new sales reps' (w75-w93), then around 40 s swaps to a 'Competitor Mention' alert card with Summarize/Explore buttons as VO says 'provides helpful real-time tips and objection handling' (w95-w102); at the end the panel starts pushing left as a new Salesforce steps screen enters.
shots.build_rebuild: Compose a 1280x720 frame with a dark video-call layout (two footage tiles plus thumbnail row) on the left 78% and a white side-panel mockup on the right, then at about 40 s crossfade the panel's insights card from the 'Scanning' placeholder to the alert card in roughly 0.3 s.
